problems.where: src/ui/sim/labSession.ts step(): the contrast lifecycle line `if (this.injector.done() && tr && tr.pushEnd !== null && el > tr.pushEnd + CONTRAST_CLEAR_S) this.finishInjection();` (CONTRAST_CLEAR_S = 3.5 at line 171). This file is outside the package's list, so it belongs in outOfScope for the build lead.
problems.problem: The lab ends the bolus 3.5 s after the push ends, whatever the collateral lag. With a typical 2 s push, bolusFor() returns null at 5.5 s. That is exactly when the CTO recipient reaches its peak (retrograde iodine 95.7 at 5.5 s, 95.3 at 6 s, 57.6 at 7 s, 22.5 at 8 s). On a 6 s donor run the recipient therefore vanishes in one frame at full opacity instead of fading, and the washout tail is never shown. That fails 'a 6 s donor run without panning fills the recipient' at 6 s and is the opposite of what diag-interp-collateral-long-run teaches. The phase also stays 'inject' until then.
problems.fix: Extend the clear time by the side's retrograde tail. Once per session or tree, compute `const net = transportNet(this.tree, caseData.lesions); this.retroTailS = { left: net.lagMax.left > 0 ? net.lagMax.left + 2 * RETRO.retentionTauS : 0, right: ... }` (transportNet, RETRO from src/render/xray/contrastTransport.ts). Change the condition to `el > tr.pushEnd + CONTRAST_CLEAR_S + this.retroTailS[tr.side]`. Alternatively, end the bolus when contrastField(...).late(lagMax) drops below a small threshold. Add a test: after a 2 s left push in diag-cto-contralateral-collaterals, bolusFor() is still non-null at 6 s and 7 s.

problems.problem: `when: { firstInjection: side }` fires on any injection attributed to that side, including a non-selective root puff that fills no coronary. In diag-two-candidate-culprits, a JL4 root puff (outcome root-puff, filledVessels []) raised total-occlusion and thrombus.
